project.name: aura-sqm
project.currentFocus: Offline runtime, simulator, and hardware-readiness path for an OpenWrt adaptive CAKE Smart Queue Management engine.
durableFacts: Repository is initialized on branch main with origin https://github.com/fatidaprilian/aura-sqm.git.
Local Git commit identity is configured as user.name=fatidaprilian and user.email=fatidaprilian@users.noreply.github.com.
Aura-SQM target runtime is linux/mipsle on OpenWrt with kmod-sched-cake and procd.
First implementation should be a single Go daemon with internal modules for config, probe, filter, control, shaper, priority, observe, and tui.
The first config format is JSON at /etc/aura-sqm/config.json, with UCI left as a later OpenWrt adapter option.
Initial code scaffold exists for cmd/aurad, cmd/aurasim, internal/config, internal/filter, internal/control, internal/observe, internal/probe, internal/runtime, and internal/shaper.
Real netlink CAKE writes remain blocked until router hardware validation is complete.
First target hardware snapshot confirms JCG Q20 on OpenWrt 22.03-SNAPSHOT, Linux 5.10.168, MediaTek MT7621, WAN interface wan, and LAN bridge br-lan.
Router SSH snapshot shows tc and kmod-sched-cake are not installed yet.
The router's configured 22.03-SNAPSHOT opkg feeds currently fail during opkg update; firmware flashing is out of scope for Aura-SQM validation.
The router feed config points only at 22.03-SNAPSHOT ramips/mt7621 and mipsel_24kc/base paths; do not rewrite feeds without explicit operator approval.
Router preflight builds default to GOMIPS=softfloat until hardfloat behavior is tested successfully on-device.
The softfloat linux/mipsle Aura-SQM binary runs from /tmp on the router and validates config/example.json without installing a persistent service.

lastAchievements: Created README.md and project docs for brief, ADR, flow, API/public contracts, data/config model, and TUI design.
Replaced scaffold design intent with a terminal UI design contract based on a latency oscilloscope anchor.
Added .gitignore for Go/OpenWrt build outputs, secrets, logs, and local agent artifacts.
Added dependency-free Go scaffold with config validation, EWMA filtering, PID control, text/Prometheus rendering, tests, and config/example.json.
Added offline runtime engine, scripted probe source, in-memory shaper, /metrics server, aurasim command, aurad --simulate mode, OpenWrt procd init skeleton, and router snapshot checklist.
Validated the Go project locally with gofmt, go test ./..., and aurasim --ticks 120 after installing Go 1.26.2.
Updated the runtime simulator so separate PID state adjusts both upload and download rates, and documented the first hardware snapshot.
Added SSH-key bootstrap and /tmp-only router deployment validation scripts for safe OpenWrt preflight.
Validated the softfloat OpenWrt build on the router from /tmp; --validate-config and --once-status passed.
pendingIssues: Router hardware facts still need validation: resolving package feeds without firmware flashing, installing ABI-compatible CAKE/tc dependencies, qdisc behavior after tc install, ingress shaping strategy, and CPU/FPU build behavior.
GitHub push still depends on available credentials or Source Control authentication.
nextBestActions: Find an ABI-compatible package path for tc, kmod-sched-cake, and kmod-ifb without firmware flashing, then capture tc -s qdisc show.
Install key-based SSH access or run scripts from an interactive terminal before collecting the router snapshot.
Create a small hardware probe before wiring netlink CAKE updates into the full control loop.
validationState: No package.json exists, so npm run validate is not available yet.
gofmt -w ./cmd ./internal completed with formatting-only changes plus one PID clamp test input correction.
go test ./... passed after two-direction simulator shaping changes.
go run ./cmd/aurasim --config config/example.json --ticks 3 showed upload and download both reducing from ceiling under high simulated latency.
OpenWrt SSH is reachable from the host network, but automated SSH failed because password/askpass authentication is required.
Manual SSH snapshot confirmed tc is missing, kmod-sched-cake is missing, overlay has 66.8 MB available, /tmp has 121.9 MB available, wan is 192.168.1.2/24, and br-lan is 192.168.10.1/24.
Manual SSH confirmed opkg architecture mipsel_24kc, kernel 5.10.168, and mipsel-openwrt-linux-musl-gcc for revision r20069-292184b6aa.
Manual opkg update failed against configured 22.03-SNAPSHOT feeds; opkg install tc-tiny failed because package lists were unavailable.
Shell syntax validation passed for router-authorize-key.sh, router-deploy-validate.sh, and router-snapshot.sh.
Cross-compilation to build/aura-sqm-openwrt-mipsle for linux/mipsle hardfloat passed locally.
Router /tmp preflight passed: AURA_CONFIG_OK and once-status showed 100000000 bps upload/download with healthy probe state.
OpenWrt service and router snapshot scripts were reviewed but not run successfully against hardware.
